title: 6515--Autoclave Benchtop
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.248-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 8 (36C248)
description_text: Autoclave GENERAL: The James A. Haley Veterans' Hospital, Microbiology Department, located at 13000 Bruce B. Downs Blvd, Tampa, Florida 33612 has a requirement for an autoclave. SCOPE: : James A Haley is requesting contractor provide a Heidolph Tuttnauer laboratory line benchtop autoclave. The scope includes delivery, installation, and training for staff on the proper use and maintenance of the autoclave. Additionally, warranties must be provided to ensure long-term functionality and reliability.
